issues.title: Make the overdue email friendlier
issues.body: Members say the overdue email sounds cold. It should be friendlier and clearer.

issues.title: Overdue emails say how many days overdue the loan is
issues.body:
## Dependencies
Blocked by #44: the line goes into the reworded email body.

## Scope
In: the body of the overdue email that `sendReminders` builds in `src/reminders.js`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a loan 7 or more days overdue, when the nightly job emails about it, the body ends with the line `This loan is N days overdue.`, where N is the whole days since the due date.
- [ ] Given a loan less than a full day overdue (the first email), the body has no days-overdue line.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Tests for every acceptance criterion
